name: Difix 3D Generation Pipeline
definition: A 3D-aware image generation and editing pipeline that uses a modified VAE with skip connections and LoRA, combined with a 1-step UNet denoiser, to process multi-view or single-view inputs.
summary: Difix is a single-step 3D-aware generation pipeline that uses a modified VAE and UNet to process multi-view inputs efficiently, differing from standard diffusion by operating at a fixed timestep.
